title: iBIOM European Pasture, Livestock & Crop Mapping WKUBE Routine
description: GENERATED from config/knobs.json by tools/gen_config.R. Resolves hosted iBIOM_Explorer/Land_use_and_management/<year>/ibiom_LUM_europe_100m_<year>.tif rasters and executes the non-GLOBIOM Pasture & Ruminant Livestock downscaling routine (using cascadecore::fienberg) and/or Cropland mapping routine inside IIASA Accelerator WKUBE.

TASK.title: Workflow Task
TASK.description: Workflow Task -- Execution task: 'trial' runs P00_check_env.R + main_pasture.R for AT, NL, ES in 2018; 'pasture' runs the pasture & ruminant livestock downscaling pipeline; 'cropland' runs main.R; 'all' runs both pasture and cropland pipelines; 'check' runs P00_check_env.R only.

YEARS.title: Reference Year(s)
YEARS.description: Reference Year(s) -- Comma-separated LAMASUS LUM reference year(s) from {2000, 2010, 2018}, or 'all' to run 2000,2010,2018.

COUNTRIES.title: Country Subset (NUTS0)
COUNTRIES.description: Country Subset (NUTS0) -- Comma-separated NUTS0 country codes (e.g. 'AT,NL,ES'), or 'all' for all mapped EU countries (excluding CY which has 0 pixels). Trial mode defaults 'all' to 'AT,NL,ES'.

RESULT_TAG.title: Result Run Tag
RESULT_TAG.description: Result Run Tag -- Run identifier used to scope output/<RESULT_TAG>/ subdirectories and output filenames.

LUM_DIR.title: Hosted LUM Root Directory
LUM_DIR.description: Hosted LUM Root Directory -- Root folder containing <year>/ibiom_LUM_europe_100m_<year>.tif (on WKUBE: /mnt/wdrv/iBIOM_Explorer/Land_use_and_management; auto-falls back to ~/accelerator/mnt/ibiom/... or input/LUM_data locally).

WORK_DIR.title: Persistent Output Work Directory
WORK_DIR.description: Persistent Output Work Directory -- Persistent shared storage directory under /mnt/wdrv where output/ is redirected so the WKUBE uploader collects artifacts.

SHARED_INPUT_DIR.title: Shared Preprocessed Input Directory
SHARED_INPUT_DIR.description: Shared Preprocessed Input Directory -- Shared drive location holding prepared non-LUM input .rds artifacts (EPIC_grass_params.rds, FAOSTAT accounts, Eurostat priors, 1 km grid mapping).

OUTPUT_DIR.title: Relative Output Directory Name
OUTPUT_DIR.description: Relative Output Directory Name -- Output directory name inside the app root (symlinked to $WORK_DIR/$OUTPUT_DIR when WORK_DIR is on /mnt/wdrv).

LIVESTOCK_SOURCE.title: Livestock Accounting Source
LIVESTOCK_SOURCE.description: Livestock Accounting Source -- National livestock herd, production, and excretion accounting source ('faostat' QCL/GLE/EMN/EK).

EMISSION_SOURCE.title: FAOSTAT GLE Emission Inventory Source
EMISSION_SOURCE.description: FAOSTAT GLE Emission Inventory Source -- Inventory series selected from FAOSTAT GLE livestock emissions ('FAO TIER 1' has complete EU coverage; 'UNFCCC' where reported).

USE_EUROSTAT_PRIORS.title: Use Eurostat NUTS2 Priors
USE_EUROSTAT_PRIORS.description: Use Eurostat NUTS2 Priors -- Use Eurostat NUTS2 livestock species shares (ef_lsk_*) and milk yields (agr_r_milkpr) as spatial priors in cascadecore::fienberg IPF ('1' = enabled, '0' = uniform national baseline).

GWP_VERSION.title: IPCC GWP100 Metric Version
GWP_VERSION.description: IPCC GWP100 Metric Version -- 100-year Global Warming Potential weights for CH4 and N2O ('AR6': 27/273, 'AR5': 28/265, 'AR4': 25/298).

EXPORT_SPATIAL.title: Export Spatial Country Outputs
EXPORT_SPATIAL.description: Export Spatial Country Outputs -- Export 24-band COG GeoTIFF, EPSG:3035 1 km centroid GeoPackage, and Apache Arrow Parquet per country ('1' = enabled, '0' = RDS/CSV only).

SKIP_EXISTING.title: Skip Completed Country Outputs
SKIP_EXISTING.description: Skip Completed Country Outputs -- Set to '1' to resume an interrupted run by skipping countries whose atomic RDS file already exists in output/<RESULT_TAG>/.

FORCE_PREP.title: Force Re-preparation Steps
FORCE_PREP.description: Force Re-preparation Steps -- Optional comma-separated preparation step names to re-run even if outputs exist (e.g. 'EPIC_grass,faostat_accounts,eurostat_priors'). Leave empty to reuse prepared inputs. OPTIONAL: leave empty for empty/default.

NCORES.title: Worker CPU Threads
NCORES.description: Worker CPU Threads -- Number of CPU threads/cores allocated to the container (data.table / GDAL threads; BLAS threads remain pinned to 1).

TRIAL.title: Trial Verification Mode
TRIAL.description: Trial Verification Mode -- When '1' (or when TASK='trial'), scopes run to YEARS='2018' and COUNTRIES='AT,NL,ES' (if COUNTRIES is 'all') for fast end-to-end verification.
